title: One place for the features many models share
summary: Stop five teams from computing the same customer features five slightly different ways.
context: Jalebi Pay has five models: fraud, credit, churn and two more. Each team wrote its own version of 'payments in the last 30 days', and the numbers disagree. Worse, what a model sees in training sometimes differs from what it sees live, and accuracy falls after launch for reasons nobody can find.
Some features must be read in milliseconds at checkout. Others are computed nightly over years of data.
must_handle: A feature has one definition, used in both training and serving.
Training can ask what a value was at a past moment, without seeing the future.
Reads for serving take a few milliseconds.
A team can see who owns a feature and which models use it.
A broken feature job is caught before models read bad values.
show_in_answer: How a feature is defined and how it reaches both worlds.
How past values are kept and looked up for training.
The online store, and how it is kept up to date.
What you check to catch a feature that has gone wrong.
